title: Command
description: A searchable command palette in a modal. Type to filter by title, description, group and keywords, move with the arrow keys, choose with Enter or a click. An optional global shortcut opens it.

support.notes: React title/keywords/description/group command data, native search, caller-preserved filter ordering, limits, reopening query reset, custom labels/hints and disabled-command exclusion in a modal. Native touch/view semantics differ from browser DOM semantics. Native devices do not expose document focus, inert, browser portals or File input APIs; H5 capabilities are specified separately. Device-runtime validation is still required. H5 supports shared-core global shortcuts and active-option keyboard navigation; native touch/confirm interactions do not expose document shortcuts. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official Taro WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

translationResources.title: Command
translationResources.description: A searchable command palette in a modal. Type to filter by title, description, group and keywords, move with the arrow keys, choose with Enter or a click. An optional global shortcut opens it.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Controlled palette; onSelect receives the chosen item and the palette closes.

shortcut.title: Global shortcut
shortcut.description: shortcut="mod+k" opens the palette with Cmd+K on macOS and Ctrl+K elsewhere; shortcutLabel shows the hint.

custom-filter.title: Ranked results
custom-filter.description: filter replaces the default substring search: it receives the enabled items and the trimmed query and returns the results in display order. Here, titles starting with the query come first.

site-search.title: Site search
site-search.description: The documentation search composes Button and CommandDialog: filtering, groups, empty results, keyboard selection and focus restoration. This example uses Ctrl+Shift+K; the site uses Cmd/Ctrl+K. Connect onSelect to your router in an application.

CommandDialogProps.open: Controlled open state; leave undefined for uncontrolled
CommandDialogProps.onOpenChange: Called with the requested open state (shortcut, selection, Escape, backdrop click)
CommandDialogProps.items: Commands to search; disabled items are never shown
CommandDialogProps.onSelect: Called with the chosen item (click or Enter); the palette then closes
CommandDialogProps.title: Title of the dialog; defaults to the localized "Command palette"
CommandDialogProps.description: Accessible description of the palette; defaults to a localized hint
CommandDialogProps.placeholder: Placeholder of the search input; defaults to a localized hint
CommandDialogProps.shortcutLabel: Shortcut hint rendered as <kbd> next to the title, e.g. "⌘K"
CommandDialogProps.shortcut: Global keyboard shortcut(s) that open the palette, e.g. "mod+k"; modifiers: mod, ctrl, meta/cmd, shift, alt/option
CommandDialogProps.filter: Custom search, e.g. ranking results by match quality: receives the enabled items and the trimmed query (never empty) and returns the matching items in display order (then capped at maxResults); defaults to a case-insensitive substring match kept in items order
CommandDialogProps.resultsLabel: Accessible label of the results list
CommandDialogProps.enterLabel: Key hint shown at the end of the search input; defaults to the localized "Enter"
CommandDialogProps.className: Additional class name of the dialog panel

CommandItem.id: Unique id, passed back through onSelect
CommandItem.title: Main label
CommandItem.group: Group name, shown as a badge and matched by the search
CommandItem.disabled: Hides the item from the results

cssVars.--command-item-min-height: Minimum height of a result row

cssVars.--command-item-padding-x: Horizontal padding of a result row (follows the density's row padding)
cssVars.--command-item-active-background: Background of the hovered / active row (defaults to a 10% primary tint)

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: items is a JS property (id, title, description, group, keywords, disabled). Type to filter, move with the arrow keys, choose with Enter or a click; minerva-select gives the chosen id.

shortcut.title: Global shortcut
shortcut.description: shortcut takes a comma-separated list ("mod+k, /"; mod is Ctrl, or ⌘ on macOS) and opens the palette from anywhere, except while typing in a field. max-results caps the list.

custom-filter.title: Ranked results
custom-filter.description: filter replaces the default substring search: it receives the enabled items and the trimmed query and returns the results in display order. Here, titles starting with the query come first.

props.label: Title of the dialog (default: localized "Command palette").

events.minerva-select: A command was chosen (detail: { value, item }, value = the item's id); the palette then closes.
events.minerva-open-change: The user asked to open (shortcut) / close (detail: { open, reason }); cancelable: preventDefault() keeps the current state.
events.minerva-after-open: The palette is open and focus moved to the search input.
events.minerva-after-close: Fired once the panel has finished closing (after its exit animation).

cssVars.--modal-width: Width of the panel (defaults to the width of the size, capped by the viewport).
cssVars.--modal-max-height: Maximum height of the panel (the body scrolls beyond).
cssVars.--modal-padding: Horizontal padding of the header, description, body and footer.
cssVars.--modal-radius: Corner radius of the panel (defaults to --radius-xl).
cssVars.--modal-z-index: Stacking order of the panel (defaults to --z-modal).
